command:
$PY - <<'PY'
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit.providers.fake_provider import FakeVigo
from qiskit.transpiler import PassManager
from qiskit.transpiler.passes import CSPLayout
qc=QuantumCircuit(3); qc.h(0);qc.cx(0,1);qc.cx(1,2);qc.measure_all()
b=FakeVigo()
pm=PassManager([CSPLayout(b.configuration().coupling_map)])
pm.run(qc)
print(pm.property_set['layout'], pm.property_set.get('CSPLayout_stop_reason'))
t=transpile(qc,backend=b,optimization_level=3,initial_layout=pm.property_set['layout'])
print(t)
